_comment: Helix.app ships the figure engine, so the app's own launcher is the normal connection: {"helix": {"command": "/Applications/Helix.app/Contents/Resources/bin/helix-mcp"}}. Use the entry below only to drive a development checkout instead; src/mcp/dev-main.ts starts the document service itself, so no terminal is needed. Do not enable both at once: the tools are identical and figures would land in whichever data directory answered.
